name: Ruetz-Backhaus Kematen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ruetz-Backhaus Kematen in Kematen in Tirol**

Discover the warm, rustic charm of **Ruetz-Backhaus Kematen**, a beloved bakery and café nestled in the heart of **Kematen in Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot invites you to savor traditional Tyrolean flavors in a welcoming atmosphere.

Indulge in freshly baked **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy **Apfelstrudel**, or a hearty **Kaserbraten** sandwich, all made with the finest local ingredients. Pair your meal with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from nearby breweries.

Whether you're exploring the scenic **Inntal** or taking a break from hiking in the **Karwendel** mountains, **Ruetz-Backhaus Kematen** is the perfect place to refuel. Experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality—**Grüß Gott!**
